# Guide

The loader lives in `src/loader.ts` and the entry point is [main](./notes/deep.md).

## Details

See `rust/lib.rs` for the crate root, or read [the notes](notes/deep.md#section).

Links that point outside the working tree, such as [the site](https://example.com/docs),
are not mentions.

A ``span holding a ` character`` must not hide `notes/after.md` later on the line.

```text
`not/a/mention.rs`
# Not a heading
```

## Wrap-up

Nothing else to say.
